name: Lexora Global Limited
about: Lexora Global Limited, through its subsidiary, engages in the trading, development, and implementation of solar photovoltaic modules, wind energy parks, and renewable energy products and infrastructure in India. It caters to residential, commercial, agricultural, and utility-scale requirements. The company was formerly known as Yash Trading and Finance Limited and changed its name to Lexora Global Limited in April 2026. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Rajkot, India.
